// diagnostic

E0512

A failure can't pass out of a `defer` body

What

A failure can't pass out of a `defer` body

Why

A `defer` body runs as its block ends, after the block's own exit was chosen, so a failure can't leave through it.

Fix

Handle the failure inside the body, with `??` or `or`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0512: tests/ui/defer_try.stderr.

Error [jet.DeferPropagatesFailure]: A failure can't pass out of a `defer` body
  --> tests/ui/defer_try.jet:8:15
    |
  8 |         print(parse("ab")?("reading the count"))
    |               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
